lines.2: I got so caught up exploring the island that I lost track of time.
lines.5: 「Heeey! Konoe! Playing is fine and all, but it's almost dark!」
lines.13: 「Look, I brought back some nuts and leaves that seem edible.」
lines.14: 「We'll manage even with your grand total of zero. Don't worry.」
lines.15: 「Ngh... If you found that much, then so can I!」
lines.16: Konoe took off toward the mountain this time.
lines.17: 「You never stop moving, do you? Hey, wait! Listen to me!」
lines.18: 「Shut up, shut up! I'm not relying on you!」
lines.19: 「Oh, come on. What am I going to do with her?」
lines.20: 「Then at least let me tell you something!」
lines.21: 「Apparently you can eat cicadas and centipedes!」
lines.22: I called after Konoe as she ran off.
lines.23: 「Good grief... I'm such a nice guy.」
lines.25: 「All right, next up: fish for dinner.」
lines.26: The scroll even explained how to start a fire. I had nothing to fear.
lines.28: 「Maybe I should've taken Tsushima up on his offer...」
lines.29: 「...I just can't let that guy see me looking weak.」
lines.31: 「That oily cicada sure is loud for this late in the day.」
lines.34: 「Maybe I should try one... It might even taste good.」
lines.35: She reached for one fairly low on a tree and caught it.
lines.36: The cicada thrashed wildly in her hand.
lines.37: 「Ugh... It doesn't look the least bit tasty.」
lines.39: The cicada flew off as if fleeing for its life.
lines.42: Konoe staggered back from the mountain.
lines.43: 「Ugh... This really drives home how pampered I usually am in the city.」
lines.45: 「Look. They're small, but I caught plenty of fish.」
lines.46: I showed her the fish roasting on skewers.
lines.48: 「Just be honest for once and say, "Let me have some."」
lines.49: 「Do that and you can eat as much as you want.」
lines.53: 「You're hungry. You didn't touch the food I left at lunch, either.」
lines.56: I held out a grilled fish.
lines.57: 「No! I don't want any fish you caught!」
lines.58: 「Are you stupid? Just eat it already.」
lines.59: 「I said I don't want it! I don't, I don't!」
lines.61: 「I ate tons of cicadas and centipedes in the mountains! I don't need your charity! The oily cicadas in particular were nice and oily...」
lines.63: I gave her an incredulous look and backed away.
lines.64: 「Huh? N-no, I was lying... No... Don't back away from me.」
lines.65: 「Hah, so it was a lie after all.」
lines.66: 「Ngh! You make my crest stand on END!!!」
lines.67: Konoe sat down and turned away from me.
lines.71: 「I'm not eating, I'm not eating, I'm not eating!!!」
lines.72: Now she was digging in her heels just for the sake of it.
lines.73: 「But I can't finish all this by myself.」
lines.74: 「The poor fish would be sad if they died just to get thrown away.」
lines.75: 「And there are people in the world who want food but can't get any.」
lines.76: 「So, would you do me a favor and eat some?」
lines.77: 「........... You're right. Wasting it would be wrong.」
lines.87: 「I feel like we went through this in middle school too, over some bread.」
lines.90: 「...All that exercise made you hungry. Eat as much as you want.」
lines.91: 「And stop looking at me like you're my guardian.」
lines.92: 「Do you have to argue with every little thing?」
lines.93: 「Hmph. ...I never knew fish could taste this good.」
lines.95: 「When I was in elementary school, the boys in my class roasted the tropical fish we'd all been taking care of on the heater.」
lines.96: 「Ever since then... I haven't really been able to eat fish.」
lines.98: Little boys can be cruel like that.
lines.99: 「So is it hard having them grilled whole like this?」
lines.100: 「I'm not that fragile. It's been years since then, so I'm fine.」
lines.103: 「...? What happened to your fingers? You've got four or five cuts.」
lines.104: 「I hate to admit it, but I kept messing up while skewering the fish on wooden sticks.」
lines.105: 「You can't just leave them like that.」
lines.106: 「Wait there. I think by the drinking fountain...」
lines.108: 「Found it. Here, some gauze. Wrap those up.」
lines.109: 「Yeah, I guess I should, just in case.」
lines.111: 「You're taking forever. Give me your hand; I'll do it.」
lines.112: Konoe deftly wrapped the gauze around my fingers.
lines.114: 「I just get irritated when people drag things like this out.」
lines.115: 「Up close, I can see your hands got a little banged up today too.」
lines.116: 「Hm? Oh, I got a few scratches trying to catch the fish.」
lines.122: A ship's horn sounded far in the distance.
lines.123: 「...Sigh. The city lights sure are far away.」
lines.124: The lights of the mainland shone across the sea.
lines.126: 「Better than not being able to see any lights at all, right?」
lines.127: 「It just makes me think everyone's over there having fun.」
lines.129: 「...No. It's my own fault for being stubborn and wasting the whole day.」
lines.134: We both gazed up at the sky.
lines.136: 「What's this? Calling yourself out now? Not bad.」
lines.139: 「I think it would've been fun if we'd worked together from the start.」
lines.140: 「I'm sorry I said I couldn't rely on you.」
lines.141: 「At times like this... you really are dependable, Tsushima.」
lines.146: 「I'm about to tell you something important.」
lines.152: 「No, I mean it tells you how to eat the island's seafood and wild plants, how to gather them, et cetera... The Principal left it for us.」
lines.153: 「...What? So you did all of that by following this?」
lines.155: 「Even though we had this, you tried to manage on your own. Sure, everything you did was pointless, but I have to admire all that futile determination--」
lines.156: 「IF YOU HAD THAT, YOU SHOULD'VE SHOWN ME SOONER!!!!」
lines.158: 「Even doing exactly what the scroll said was pretty hard!」
lines.159: 「And I tried to show it to you, but you didn't listen to a single word I said! You kept charging into the mountains and the sea like some savage!」
lines.161: 「Hah. Hit the mark, did I? Is that why you're red with rage?」
lines.162: 「That's not why my face is red!」
lines.163: 「...Ahh, there it is, my crest standing on end! Just like that time.」
lines.164: 「You always get me all worked up, then at the very last second--BOOOOM! What is WRONG with you!?」
lines.165: 「Um... Could you say that in Japanese instead of twin-tail language?」
lines.166: I had no clue what she meant.
lines.168: She grabbed me and rattled me back and forth.
lines.169: 「Whoa, stop, you idiot! Quit shaking me--you're going to scramble my brain!」
lines.170: 「Your brain ought to get scrambled at least once!」
